Definition: from the same as G3619; confirmation:--edifying.
BiblicalUsage: Oikodomia is the noun for edifying, or confirmation, but it has no occurrence in the Greek text behind this study. The word stands once in the older text, in 1 Timothy 1:4, where the King James Version reads godly edifying and the reading now followed says stewardship of God instead, and this study follows the King James reading.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lesson of this word is that the older text and the newer text sometimes part ways, and the stewardship of God is the reading the church now hears.
